usedFor: Shopify holds your store and checkouts, and JobNimbus keeps your customers when “Abandoned Checkout” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in JobNimbus
bestTemplate.why: Someone who left a checkout with an email or phone becomes a JobNimbus contact you can call back.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so the contact appears after a scheduled check.
